# kinematics.types: SpatialVelocity3D

**Status:** Experimental (tier `future`). Aspirational vocabulary. It must parse and type-check; it is not linted or converted to C#.

## Summary

> A spatial velocity: the linear velocity of a reference point in meters per
> second, plus the angular velocity in radians per second about each axis.
> Known as a twist in screw theory.
> (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Screw\_theory)
